mapper.sql: select c.id, c.activity_id, c.signup_id, c.volunteer_user_id, c.checkin_time, c.checkout_time, c.checkin_method, c.checkout_method, c.status, c.abnormal_reason, c.manual_reason, c.operator_id, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, a.title as activity_title, a.activity_type, a.service_location, a.start_time as activity_start_time, a.end_time as activity_end_time, s.real_name as volunteer_real_name, s.phone as volunteer_phone, s.organization as volunteer_organization from vol_checkin_record c left join vol_activity a on a.id = c.activity_id left join vol_activity_signup s on s.id = c.signup_id
